tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rtags kyi 'jug pa'i snying po'i don mdo tsam brjod pa dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes dpyid// gzhon nu'i gzugs kyis rnam rol ba// rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs btud nas// mkhas mchog thon mi'i thugs mtsho las// byung ba'i brda sprod phyi mo mchog /rtags kyi 'jug pa'i snying po'i don// mdor bsdus tshig gis gsal bar bya// spyir ni dbyangs mo gsal byed pho// de phyir kā li sum cu po// pho yi yi ge 'ba' zhig la// nang gses sde tshan lngar dbye ste// ka ca ta pa tsa rnams pho// kha cha tha pha tsha ma ning*// ga ja da ba dza wa zha// za 'a ya sha sa rnams mo// nga nya na ma shin tu mo// ra la ha a mo gsham ste// a ni mtshan med ces kyang bya// sngon 'jug lnga yi ba yig pho// ga da ma ning 'a mo yig /ma ni shin tu mo yin no// de rnams gang la gang 'jug na// pho yig ba ni ka ca ta// tsa ga nga ja nya da na// dza zha za ra sha sar 'jug /ma ning ga ni ca ta tsa// nya da na zha za ya sha /sar 'jug ma ning da yig ni// ka pa ga ba nga mar 'jug /mo yig 'a ni ga ja da// ba dza kha cha tha pha tshar// shin tu mo yi ma yig ni// kha cha tha tsha ga ja da// dza nga nya na rnams la 'jug /ji ltar 'jug par byed ce na// pho ni sgra rtsol drag par 'jug /ma ning ran par 'jug pa yin// mo ni zhan pa'i tshul gyis te// shin tu mo ni mnyam pas so// ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na// thog mar 'di ltar shes dgos te// las gang zhig la byed pa po// gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba yi// dbang du byas nas byed po dang*// de yi byed pa gnyis po ni// dngos po bdag yin bya yul dang*// bya ba gnyis po dngos po gzhan// de bzhin byed pa po gzhan dang*// dngos su 'brel min ji ltar yang*// bya ba byas zin 'das pa dang*// bya ba byed 'gyur ma 'ongs dang*// byed bzhin pa ni da lta ba// de phyir dus gsum dbye bas ni// byed las dang 'brel ngag gi ni// sbyor ba kun la khyab pa yin// bdag gzhan dbye bas de tsam du// khyab pa min yang byed po dang*// bya yul bsdu phyir dbye ba de// mdzad nas bdag gzhan dang 'brel ba'i// bya byed rnams kyang de khongs bsdus// des na dus gsum du dbye ba// bdag gzhan dbye bas ma khyab pa// bsdu ba'i don du shes dgos par// gsungs kyang sngon 'jug 'a yig skabs// byed las tsam dang 'brel ba yi// dngos po bdag la'ang 'jug pa mthong*// de ltar nges nas pho yig ba// bsgrubs so lta bu 'das pa dang*// bsgrub bya'i lha dang bsgrub par bya// zhes sogs dngos po gzhan la 'jug

/ma ning ga da gnyis po ni// gcod pa po dang gcod par byed// gcod par 'gyur dang dkri ba po// dkri bar byed dang dkri bar 'gyur// zhes sogs dngos po bdag don dang*// gcad bya'i shing dang gcad par bya// dkri bya'i snal ma dkri bar bya// zhes sogs dngos po gzhan don dang*// gcod bzhin pa dang dkri bzhin pa// zhes sogs da lta bsgrub ched 'jug /mo yig 'a ni 'chad pa po// 'chad par byed dang 'chad par 'gyur// zhes sogs dngos po bdag dngos dang*// 'gro ba po dang 'gro bar byed// ces sogs bdag don phal pa dang*// 'khyil lo zhes sogs da lta dang*// 'khyil bar 'gyur sogs ma 'ongs 'jug /shin tu mo yi ma yig ni// bdag gzhan dus gsum mnyam par 'jug /'on kyang byed po gzhan dngos dang*// 'brel ba'i 'das la 'a'i sngon 'jug /med par nges shing ga da nyung*// da lta ba la ba'i sngon 'jug /nyung zhing mgo can da lta bar// bas 'phul med par nges pa tsam// gzhan yang bas 'phul can phal cher// byed pa po ni da lta dang*// bya yul ma 'ongs par bsdus nas// 'das la bas 'phul yang 'jug yod// da lta ba la gnyis ka med// ma 'ongs 'phul yod yang 'jug med// skul tshig 'phul med yang 'jug yod// skabs 'gar 'das dang skul tshig la// sa rkyang sbyar bas 'thus pa'ang yod// rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po yi// ga da ba sa bzhi rnams pho// nga ma 'a gsum mo yin cing*// na ra la gsum ma ning ste// ming gzhi'i yi ge kun la 'jug /ji ltar 'jug tshul gnyis yin te// dang po sgra yi 'jug tshul ni// pho yi ga yig yang 'jug can// skyes bu rab dang pho yig ba// yang 'jug can ni skyes bu 'bring*// ga ba yang 'jug med pa dang*// da sa'i mtha' can tha ma ste// drag pa pho la'ang nang gses kyis// drag zhan bar ma gsum du dbye// de bzhin zhan pa mo la yang*// nang gses drag zhan gnyis dbye ste// nga ma yang 'jug can mo dang*// nga ma yang 'jug med pa dang*// 'a mtha' can rnams shin tu mo// bar ma ma ning na ra la// yang 'jug yod dam med kyang rung*// ming gzhi pho yig mthar yod dang*// ming gzhi ma ning rjes su ni// yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pa na// drag dang 'phrad pas drag par 'gyur// ming gzhi mo yig rjes su ni// yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na// zhan dang 'phrad pas zhan par 'gyur// de gnyis 'gyur ba ma ning yin// ming gzhi mo yig rjes su ni// yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pa na// drag zhan gnyis ka'i cha ldan phyir// mtshan gnyis ma ning zhes su grags// ming gzhi ma ning rjes su ni// yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na// drag zhan gang du'ang mi 'gyur bas// mtshan med ma ning zhes su 'dod// gnyis pa don la gnyis yod pa'i// snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba ni// rjes 'jug gang la zhugs pa yi// ming des bdag gzhan sogs gang ston// phal cher ming de'i sngon 'jug gi

/nus par sbyar nas rtogs par bya// phyi ma ji ltar 'gyur ba ni// rjes 'jug pho yis pho yig gi /ming mtha' gzhan drangs de bzhin du// mo yis mo yi ming mtha' dang*// ma ning gis ni ma ning drangs// de rnams rtags mtshungs 'dren tshul te// brjod bde 'dren pa'ang shin tu mang*// gzhan yang ming mtha' de nyid kyis// rtags mtshungs pa 'am sgra mthun pa'i// rnam dbye brgyad dang slar bsdu sogs// snga ma'i shugs dang mthun par 'dren// de dag nang gses gang 'jug ni// rnam dbye'am 'phrad ces ming tshig de'i// mthar sbyar ming don las shes bya// de yang chos rnams ngo bo tsam// brjod pa rnam dbye dang po ste// dper na bum pa ka ba bzhin// gsal byed bod kyi skad la nyung*// las dang bya yul don gcig ste// de lta'i bya ba'i yul zhig la// bya ba byas par ston pa la// gnyis pa las su bya ba dang*// gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid dang*// bzhi pa dgos ched gsum 'dra yang*// bya ba byas pas bya ba'i yul// de 'am de dang 'brel ba la// phan thogs med na gnyis pa ste// dper na shar du 'gro lta bu// phan thogs yod na bzhi pa ste// dper na slong la sbyin lta bu// phan thogs med kyang bya yul dang*// bya ba ngo bo gcig yin na// gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid de// dper na lha ru gsal lta bu// gang zhig gang la brten pa 'am// gnas dang yod pa'i don tsam las// bya ba gtan nas mi byed na// rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi ste// dper na steng du mi yod ltar// tshe skabs gnyis dang don 'dra na// bdun pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs te// dper na mchu zla shar ba na// cho 'phrul dus chen tshugs lta bu// rnam dbye gnyis bzhi bdun pa dang*// de nyid tshe skabs gsal byed sgra// su ra ru du na la tu// yin zhing phal cher la sgra dang*// mthun pas la don rnam dbye'ang zer// 'on kyang na la de nyid la// mi 'jug smra ba'i sgo las gsungs// rnam dbye gang la sbyor yul des// nye 'gyangs gang du bya ba zhig

/byas na gsum pa byed sgra ste// dper na bdag gis bshad lta bu// bya ba gtan nas mi byed par// snga phyi 'brel byed tsam ston na// rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra ste// dper na bdag gi mig lta bu// rnam dbye gsum drug gsal byed sgra// sa mtha' yod dang med pa yi// gi kyi gyi 'i yi lnga yin// gang zhig gang las byung ba 'am// bye dang lhung ba'i don ldan na// rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs te// dper na zhal nas thos lta bu// gsal byed sgra ni nas las te// dgar dang sdud pa'ang lnga par gtogs// gzhan yang tshig don gong 'og tu// bsdu rgyu yod na sdud pa'i sgra// dang dang kyang yang 'ang sogs sbyor// rnam grangs du mas don bskyar na// 'byed sdud sgra 'jug dgag pa dang*// bdag don yod na thog mtha' ru// pa sde'i rtags rnams ci rigs 'jug /rgyan du gyur pa'i tshig phrad kyang*// don la bsnyegs sa yod na sbyor// de bzhin bstan bya lhag yod na// lhag bcas sgra sbyor tshig don ni// rdzogs na slar bsdu'i sgra rnams sbyor// dgos pa ci phyir 'jug ce na// mo yig dbyangs dang mi ldan na// pho yig gsal byed brjod mi nus// de phyir dbyangs lngar bzhed pa bde// pho yig dbyangs ldan de dag la'ang*// rjes 'jug bcu po ma zhugs na// don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i// ming dang don gyi khyad par rnams// ston pa'i tshig dang don ldan pa'i// ngag gi brjod pa yod min te// yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung zhing*// ming gi khongs nas tshig phyung nas// tshig gis don rnams ston pas so// ming tshig brjod pa med na ni// mthun mong mthun mong ma yin pa'i// shes bya ston pa'ang med par 'gyur// de phyir 'phags yul mkhas rnams kyi// rjes su 'brangs nas gsungs pa 'di// skye bo kun gyis rtogs gyur cig /tshig gi sgra tsam 'dra na yang*// don la khyad par shin tu che// de phyir brda dag la brten nas// ma nor don rnams 'tshol ba gces// don la mi rmongs rmongs pa yang*// lugs 'dir mkhas min gyis byed de// sgra shes don la mi rmongs zhes// mkhas pa'i gsung la yongs su grags// 'di la ma sbyangs rmongs tshod kyis// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i grwar 'jug pa// wa skyes seng lpags gyon pa bzhin// nam zhig rjes ngan gsal bar 'gyur// de phyir blo gsal don gnyer rnams// rtags 'jug dka' gnad gzugs brnyan kun// gsal bar 'char ba'i me long 'dir// la 'ur gzigs mor spyon dang kye// 'di la nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na// gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyan sngar 'chags// cung zad 'bad las thob pa'i dges// kun gyis 'di don rtogs par shog// /ces rtags kyi 'jug pa'i snying po'i don mdo tsam brjod pa dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/

rang gi slob bu rje drung sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang don grub phun tshogs gnyis nas dgos tshul ltar/ mkhas mchog si tu paṇa chen dang thams cad mkhyen pa dharma bha dra dpal bzang po'i bzhed pa dang mthun par dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/// / ༄༅// rtags 'jug dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long gi 'grel pa rigs lam gser gyi lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ mkha' khyab shes bya yongs kyi gshis lugs chos// brjod bral 'gyur med dbyings su mngon gzigs pa// rgyal ba kun las bka' drin lhag pa'i mgon// dka' 'gyur chos kyi rgyal po gtsug na rgyal// dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes ma lus pa// gcig bsdus rang gzugs smra ba ngag gi lha// brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i 'jo sgeg gar rtsen pa// 'jam dpal rdo rje rnon pos dge legs stsol// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos tshul tam bu ra'i// sgra las drangs pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor kun// skal bzang thos 'dzin dpyid du 'jo mdzad ma// sgra ldan lha kye snying la rol par mdzod// dbyangs can thugs la grub pa'i rdo rje yi// zab yangs blo gros mtho ris skyed tshal las// legs 'ongs rtags 'jug pad+ma 'dzum pa'i zhal// rnam dpyod nyin byed snang bas dbye bar bya// kwa ye blo gsal rkang drug gzhon nu rnams// brda dag sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston spyod 'dod na// legs bshad me tog kha sgo phye ba'i dus// dga' ba'i glu dbyangs dang bcas zhugs par rigs// de la 'dir snyigs dus kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dngul chu dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba rtags 'jug dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long 'di nyid sa bcad rgyas pa sogs dor nas mdor bsdus su 'chad pa la gsum/ mchod brjod/ brtsam par dam bca'/ gzhung don dngos so// dang po mchod brjod la yang rgya skad dang bod skad gnyis las dang po rgya skad kyi sgo nas mchod brjod ni/

na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ zhes pa/ byang phyogs kha ba can pa stod mnga' ris skor gsum rdzing bu lta bu/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba lta bu/ smad mdo khams sgang drug zhing sa dang 'dra bar yod la/ de la yang bod dang bod chen po gnyis las bod dbus gtsang gi skad du/ na mo phyag 'tshal lo// mañdzu 'jam/ shrī dpal/ ye la ste/ 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa bod skad kyi sgo nas mchod par brjod pa ni/ rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes dpyid// gzhon nu'i gzugs kyis rnam rol ba// rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs btud nas// zhes pa/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab kyi ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i dpyid de snying po/ gzhon nu na tshod bcu drug lon pa'i gzugs kyis rnam par rol pa/ rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo ste 'jam dpal dbyangs dang ngo bo dbyer med pa rang la mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam ma nor bar ston pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa dharma bha dra sogs dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos btud nas/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa brtsam par dam bca' ni/ mkhas mchog thon mi'i thugs mtsho las// byung ba'i brda sprod phyi mo mchog /rtags kyi 'jug pa'i snying po'i don// mdor bsdus tshig gis gsal bar bya// zhes pa/ gangs can sā la'i sman ljongs 'dir mkhas grub nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar byon pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa thon mi nyid kyi thugs kyi rgya mtsho chen po las byung ba'i yul gangs can gyi skad kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos kun gyi phyi mo'am ma phyi'am gzhi'am rtsa ba mchog tu gyur pa sum rtags gnyis las rtags kyi 'jug pa'i snying po'i don rnams ma tshang ba med par mdor bsdus pa'i tshig gi sgo nas gsal bar bya/ zhes pa'o// gsum pa gzhung don dngos ni/ spyir na dbyangs mo gsal byed pho// de phyir kā li sum cu po// zhes pa/

ming gzhi'i yi ge spyi'i rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa ste/ spyir yi ge la dbye na dbyangs dang gsal byed gnyis su yod/ de las dbyangs kyi bya ba gsal bar mtshon par byed pa/ i ste gi gu/ u ste zhabs kyu/ e ste 'greng bu/ o ste rna ru bzhi ni mo dang*/ kā li'i bya ba gsal bar byed pa'i ka nas a'i bar gyi yi ge sum cu po rnams ni phor shes par bya'o// zhes pa'o// pho yi yi ge 'ba' zhig la// nang gses sde tshan lngar dbye ste// zhes pa/ pho yig sum cu po de rnams nang gses sde tshan so sor dbye na lngar 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/ pho dang*/ ma ning dang*/ mo dang*/ shin tu mo dang*/ mo gsham ste lngar 'gyur ro// 'ba' zhig ni kho na zhes pa'i don no// de lnga'i dang po pho ni/ ka ca ta pa tsa rnams pho// zhes pa/ ka dang*/ ca dang*/ ta dang*/ pa dang*/ tsa bcas lnga po de rnams pho yig go /gnyis pa ma ning ni/ kha cha tha pha tsha ma ning*// zhes pa/ kha dang*/ cha dang*/ tha dang*/ pha dang*/ tsha bcas lnga ni ma ning gi yi ge 'o// gsum pa mo ni/ ga ja da ba dza wa zha// za 'a ya sha sa rnams mo// zhes pa/ ga dang*/ ja dang*/ da dang*/ ba dang*/ dza dang*/ wa dang*/ zha dang*/ za dang*/ 'a dang*/ ya dang*/ sha dang*/ sa bcas bcu gnyis po 'di rnams mo yig go /bzhi pa shin tu mo ni/ nga nya na ma shin tu mo// zhes pa/ nga dang*/ nya dang*/ na dang*/ ma bcas bzhi po shin tu mo'i yi ge'o// lnga pa mo gsham gyi yi ge ni/ ra la ha a mo gsham ste// zhes pa/ ra dang*/ la dang*/ ha dang*/ a dang bcas bzhi ni mo gsham gyi yi ge'o// a ni mtshan med ces kyang bya// zhes pa/ a ni mo gsham gyi yi ge yin par ma zad/ sgra rtsol shin tu zhan pas mtshan med ces kyang bya ba ste zer ba yin no// zhes pa'o//

sngon 'jug lnga yi ba yig pho// zhes pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa ste/ rang gi 'jug yul du gyur pa'i ming gzhi'i sngon du 'jug pa'i sngon 'jug lnga ni/ legs bshad ljon dbang las/ ga da ba ma 'a sngon 'jug /ces pa ltar sngon 'jug lnga po de'i nang nas ba yig ni pho yin no// ga da ma ning*/ zhes pa/ ga da gnyis sngon 'jug gi ma ning dang*/ 'a mo yig /ces pa/ 'a ni mo dang*/ ma ni shin tu mo yin no// zhes pa/ ma ni shin tu mor 'gyur ba yin no// de rnams gang la gang 'jug na// zhes pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa ste/ gong du bshad pa'i yi ge de rnams ming gzhi'i yi ge gang la sngon 'jug gang 'jug ce na/ pho yig ba ni ka ca ta// tsa ga nga ja nya da na// dza zha za ra sha sar 'jug /ces pa/ sngon 'jug gi pho yig ba ni/ ka dang*/ ca dang*/ ta dang*/ tsa dang*/ ga dang*/ nga dang*/ ja dang*/ nya dang*/ da dang*/ na dang*/ dza dang*/ zha dang*/ za dang*/ ra dang*/ sha dang*/ sa bcas yi ge bcu drug po 'di rnams la 'jug cing*/ ka la rkyang brtsegs 'dogs gsum gyi sgo nas 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ bka'/ bska/ bkye/ bkra/ bskyangs/ ca la rkyang 'phul kho nas 'jug pa dper na/ bcas/ bcom/ bcug /lta bu/ ta la rkyang brtsegs gnyis kyis 'jug ste dper na/ btab/ btud/ btags/ brtags/ blta/ bstar/ lta bu/ tsa la rkyang brtsegs kyis 'jug pa ni/ btsal/ btsos/ btsugs/ brtsegs/ lta bu/ ga la rkyang 'dogs brtsegs gsum gyis 'jug pa ni/ bgo /bgrad/ bgyis/ brgal/ bsgoms/ lta bu/ nga la brtsegs 'phul kho nas 'jug pa ni/ brngams/ bsngags/ lta bu/ ja la brtsegs 'phul kho nas 'jug pa/ brjes/ brjid/ lta bu/ nya la brtsegs 'phul kho nas/ brnyan/ bsnyen/ lta bu/ da la rkyang brtsegs gnyis kyis 'jug pa ni/ bde/ brda/ bldag /bsdad/ lta bu/ na la brtsegs 'phul kho nas/ brnag /bsnams/ lta bu/ dza la brtsegs 'phul kho nas 'jug pa ni/ brdzes/ brdzis/ lta bu/ zha la rkyang 'phul/

bzhag /bzhi/ bzhes/ lta bu/ za la rkyang 'dogs gnyis/ dper na/ bzang*/ bzi/ bzung*/ bzed/ bzo/ bzlas/ lta bu/ ra la 'dogs 'phul kho nas 'jug pa ni/ brlabs/ lta bu/ sha la rkyang 'phul kho nas 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ bshad/ bshes/ lta bu/ sa la rkyang 'dogs gnyis kyis 'jug pa/ bsam/ bsu/ bse/ bsos/ bsris/ bsrungs/ bsres/ bsros/ bslab/ lta bu/ ma ning ga ni ca ta tsa// nya da na zha za ya sha /sar 'jug /ces pa/ sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga ni ming gzhi'i/ ca dang*/ ta dang*/ tsa dang*/ nya dang*/ da dang*/ na dang*/ zha dang*/ za dang*/ ya dang*/ sha dang*/ sa bcas bcu gcig la rkyang 'phul kho nas 'jug pa ni/ gcod/ gter/ gtso/ gnyen/ gdong/ gnad/ gzhal/ gzigs/ g.yang*/ gshegs/ gsung*/ lta bu/ ma ning da yig ni// ka pa ga ba nga mar 'jug /ces pa/ sngon 'jug gi ma ning da yig ni ming gzhi'i/ ka dang*/ pa dang*/ ga dang*/ ba dang*/ nga dang*/ ma bcas drug po 'di rnams la 'jug cing*/ de yang nga la rkyang 'phul dang gzhan lnga la rkyang 'dogs gnyis te/ dper na/ dkar/ dkyil/ dkrigs/ dpal/ dpral/ dpyid/ dga'/ dgra/ dgyes/ dbang*/ dbri/ dbyibs/ dngul/ dma'/ dmigs/ dmyal/ lta bu/ mo yig 'a ni ga ja da// ba dza kha cha tha pha tshar// zhes pa/ ga dang*/ ja dang*/ da dang*/ ba dang*/ dza dang*/ kha dang*/ cha dang*/ tha dang*/ pha dang*/ tsha bcas bcu po la mo yig 'a 'jug pa las/ ga la rkyang 'dogs gnyis kyis 'jug pa ni/ 'ga'/ 'gro/ 'gyel/ ja la rkyang 'phul ni/ 'jal/ da la rkyang 'dogs kyi dpe ni/ 'dab/ 'di/ 'dra/ ba la rkyang 'dogs dper na/ 'ba'/ 'brog /'byor/ dza la rkyang 'phul ni/ 'dzer/ 'dzum/ 'dzol/ kha la rkyang 'dogs/ 'khor/ 'khrul/ 'khri/ 'khyir/ cha la rkyang 'phul/ 'chad/ 'chang*/ 'char/ tha la rkyang 'phul/ 'thob/ pha la rkyang 'dogs/ 'phar/ 'phreng*/ 'phyi/ tsha la rkyang 'phul/ 'tshal/ lta bu/ shin tu mo yi ma yig ni// kha cha tha tsha ga ja da// dza nga nya na rnams la 'jug /ces pa/ sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig ni ming gzhi'i/ kha dang*/ cha dang*/ tha dang*/ tsha dang*/ ga dang*/

ja dang*/ da dang*/ dza dang*/ nga dang*/ nya dang*/ na bcas bcu gcig la 'jug pa'i kha ga gnyis la rkyang 'dogs dang*/ gzhan ma rkyang 'phul dper na/ mkha'/ mkhris/ mkhyen/ mchis/ mthong*/ mtshungs/ mgon/ mgrin/ mgyogs/ mjal/ mda'/ mdzod/ mnga'/ mnyam/ mnan/ lta bu/ ji ltar 'jug par byed ce na// pho ni sgra rtsol drag par 'jug /ma ning ran par 'jug pa yin// mo ni zhan pa'i tshul gyis te// shin tu mo ni mnyam pas so// zhes pa/ sgra rtsol dang mthun pa'i sgo nas ji ltar 'jug par byed pa yin nam zer na/ sngon 'jug gi pho ba ni rang gi 'jug yul ming gzhi'i ye ge rnams la sgra ste skad gdangs che ba dang*/ rtsol ba zhes pa dbugs la sogs pa'i rtsol ba shin tu che bas sgra rtsol drag par 'jug pa dang*/ ma ning ga da gnyis ni sgra rtsol cha snyoms ran pa ste 'tshams par 'jug pa dang*/ mo 'a yig ni sgra rtsol zhan pa ste chung ba'i tshul gyis 'jug pa dang*/ shin tu mo ma yig ni sgra rtsol mo las kyang shin tu zhan pas na mnyam pas so zhes pa'o// ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na// zhes pa/ sngon 'jug lnga po de rnams 'jug yul ming gzhi'i ye ge rnams la dgos pa ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ thog mar 'di ltar shes dgos te// las gang zhig la byed pa po// gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba yi// dbang du byas nas byed po dang*// de yi byed pa gnyis po ni// dngos po bdag yin bya yul dang*// bya ba gnyis po dngos po gzhan// zhes pa/ sngon 'jug gi ci phyir 'jug gi gzhung don zhib tu shes pa la thog mar 'di ltar shes par byed dgos te/ las sam bya yul la bya ba zhig byed rgyu yod na bdag gzhan dus gsum gyi dbye ba 'jug la/ las sam bya yul la bya ba byed rgyu med na bdag gzhan dus gsum gyi dbye ba mi 'jug /de la byed po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas byed po gang zag dang de'i byed pa ni shing gcod pa lta bur mtshon na sta re yin pas de gnyis ni/

bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag yin/ des bsgrub par bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po dang bya ba gnyis po ni bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan yin/ de yang bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po ni shing yin/ bya ba ni shing gcod pa'i las ka sta re'i 'degs 'jog dang shing dum bur btub pa sogs yin/ dpe brjod kyi skabs su/ shing gcod pa po/ shing gcod po/ zhes pa'i sgra 'di lta bus byed po gang zag shing mkhan go bas bdag gzhan gnyis nas bdag yin/ gcod par byed/ gcod do// lta bu byed las gsal byed kyi sgra zer ba yin no// don du byed pa sta re dang de 'degs pa'i bya ba go dgos/ bdag gzhan gnyis nas de yang bdag yin/ gcad bya/ gcad par bya ba/ gcad bya'i shing*/ lta bu 'di rnams tshig brjod tshul mi 'dra ba byung yang don gcig cing bya yul gsal byed kyi sgra zer ba yin/ 'di skabs bya yul shing go dgos shing bdag gzhan gnyis nas gzhan yin/ gcad par bya/ gcad do// lta bu 'di rnams la bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba'i bya ba gsal byed kyi sgra zer ba yin/ 'di skabs sta re 'degs pa'i bya ba shing gi steng du babs nas shing bkas pa dang dum bur 'gro ba sogs go dgos shing bdag gzhan gnyis nas gzhan yin/ bdag gzhan gnyis kyi dbye ba de ltar blo la bzhag nas/ dus gsum gyi dbye ba ni/ de bzhin byed pa po gzhan dang*// dngos su 'brel min ji ltar yang*// bya ba byas zin 'das pa dang*// bya ba byed 'gyur ma 'ongs dang*// byed bzhin pa ni da lta ba// zhes pa/ gong du bdag gzhan so sor dbye ba de bzhin du byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel yang rung*/ ma 'brel yang rung ji ltar yin na yang*/ bya ba byas zin pa ni 'das pa dang*/ dper na/ lha bsgrubs/ shing bcad/ lta bu dang*/ bya ba byed 'gyur ni ma 'ongs pa dper na/ lha bsgrub/ bsgrub par bya/ bsgrub bya/ bsgrub par bya ba/ bsgrub bya'i lha/

gcad bya/ gcad par bya ba/ gcad par bya/ gcad do// gcad bya'i shing*/ 'di rnams dus gsum nas dus ma 'ongs pa yin/ bya ba byed bzhin pa da ltar ba ni dper na/ lha sgrub/ sgrub bo// sgrub bzhin pa/ sgrub kyin 'dug /sgrub par byed/ sgrub byed/ shing gcod par byed/ gcod do// gcod byed/ gcod bzhin pa/ gcod kyin 'dug /lta bu 'di rnams da lta ba yin/ yang bya byed las gsum zer rgyu 'di ngos 'dzin yag po shes dgos pas/ gcod po dang*/ sgrub pa po/ lta bu 'di rnams bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas byed pa yin/ gcod par byed/ gcad par bya/ gcad do// sgrub par byed/ bsgrub par bya/ bsgrub bo// lta bu bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya ba yin/ gcad bya/ gcad par bya ba/ gcad bya'i shing*/ bsgrub bya/ bsgrub par bya ba/ bsgrub bya'i lha/ lta bu 'di rnams bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas las zer ba de yin te/ bstan bcos 'di yi gsham du/ las dang bya yul don gcig ste// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang byed pa la gtso phal gnyis yod pas gcod pa po shing gcod mkhan gang zag de gtso bo yin/ gcod byed sta re phal pa yin/ shing gcad pa bya ba yin cing de la byed pa po la yod pa'i bya ba dang*/ bya ba'i yul la yod pa'i bya ba gnyis yod de/ sta res shing gcod pa'i rtsol ba ni byed pa po shing mkhan la yod cing de gsal byed kyi sgra ni/ gcod par byed zer ba 'di yin/ shing dum bur bcad pa'i cha ni bya yul shing gi steng du yod cing de gsal byed kyi sgra ni/ gcad do// gcad par bya/ zhes pa 'di yin no// 'di skabs mkhas pa so so'i bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba mang po 'dug kyang rang lugs 'di ltar 'thad par sems so// yang gong du dngos po bdag yin zhes pa'i dngos po de rtags 'jug rtsa ba na dngos su gsungs med pas gsar bu ba rnams la ma sbyar na re zhig go bde zhing*/ dngos po dang dngos can gyi dngos po de yin zer ba gu dog 'ba' zhig go

/ de phyir dus gsum dbye bas ni// byed las dang 'brel ngag gi ni// sbyor ba kun la khyab pa yin// zhes pa/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir dus gsum gyi dbye bas ni byed las dang 'brel ba'i ngag gi sbyor ba thams cad la khyab pa yin/ zhes pa'o// de yang go bde bar brjod na byed las dang 'brel ba'i ngag yin tshad thams cad yang na dus 'das pa yin dgos/ yang na dus ma 'ongs pa yin dgos/ yang na da lta ba yin dgos/ zhes pa'i don no// bdag gzhan dbye bas de tsam du// khyab pa min yang byed po dang*// bya yul bsdu phyir dbye ba de/ /mdzad nas bdag gzhan dang 'brel ba'i// bya byed rnams kyang de khongs bsdus// zhes pa/ bdag gzhan gyi dbye bas byed las dang 'brel ba'i ngag gi sbyor ba thams cad la dus gsum gyi dbye bas khyab pa de tsam du ma khyab kyang*/ 'o na gang la ma khyab ce na/ gdugs su 'khyir/ chur 'khyil/ lta bu 'di rnams la dus gsum gyi dbye bas khyab kyang bdag gzhan gyi dbye bas ma khyab pa ste bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba'i khongs su ma gtogs so// bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba mdzad pa'i dgos pa ni/ sgrub pa po/ bsgrub bya'i lha/ lta bu byed pa po dang bya yul gnyis bsdu ba'i phyir du dbye ba de mdzad nas/ de'i zhar la bdag gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya byed kyi tshig phan tshun shed mtshungs pa rnams kyang de khongs bsdus zhes pa'o// bya byed kyi sgra shed mtshungs bdag gzhan gyi khongs su bsdu tshul ji ltar yin snyam na/ sgrub par byed/ ces pa'i tshig 'di sgrub pa po zhes pa dang shed mtshungs yin pas bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag gi khongs su bsdus/ bsgrub par bya/ zhes pa 'di bsgrub bya'i lha zhes pa dang shed mtshungs yin pas bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan gyi khongs su bsdus/ yang bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba ma mdzad na cir 'gyur snyam na/ ma mdzad na skyon 'di ltar/ dper na/ skal ldan gyis sangs rgyas bsgrubs lta bu'i tshe/

bsgrubs zhes pa'i tshig kho nas dus 'das pa go nus kyang*/ skal ldan dang sangs rgyas de ji lta bu yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa 'byung ba'i skyon yod/ bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba mdzad pas skal ldan de bdag byed po dang*/ sangs rgyas bsgrub par bya ba gzhan de yin pa bde blag tu go ba'i dgos pa yod pas de'i phyir bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba mdzad do// des na dus gsum du dbye ba// bdag gzhan dbye bas ma khyab pa// bsdu ba'i don du shes dgos par// gsungs kyang sngon 'jug 'a yig skabs// byed las tsam dang 'brel ba yi// dngos po bdag la'ang 'jug pa mthong*// zhes pa/ des na 'das pa/ ma 'ongs pa/ da lta ba bcas dus gsum du dbye ba'i dgos pa ni/ bdag gzhan gyi dbye bas ma khyab pa'am ma bsdus pa lcags gser du gyur lta bu dus 'das pa dang*/ chu 'khyil bar 'gyur lta bu dus ma 'ongs pa dang*/ gdugs 'khyil gyin 'dug /'khyir bzhin pa'o// lta bu dus da lta ba rnams su bsdu ba'i don du shes dgos par gsungs kyang sngon 'jug 'a yig skabs byed las tsam dang 'brel ba yi/ chos 'chad pa po/ 'chad par byed/ lta bu dngos po bdag la'ang 'jug pa mthong ngo*// zhes pa'o// de ltar nges nas pho yig ba// zhes pa/ bshad ma thag pa de ltar tshul bzhin nges nas sngon 'jug gi pho yig ba ni/ dus 'das pa dang*/ gzhan gnyis la 'jug pa'i dper brjod ni/ zhes pa'o// bsgrubs so lta bu 'das pa dang*// zhes pa/ bsgrubs so// bkang*/ bcad/ lta bu 'di rnams dus 'das pa yin pas des mtshon nas rgya cher shes par bya'o// bsgrub bya'i lha dang bsgrub par bya/ /zhes sogs dngos po gzhan la 'jug /ces pa/ pho yig ba bsgrub bya'i lha sogs dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa'i dpe ni/ bsgrub bya/ bsgrub par bya ba/ bsgrub bya'i lha/ bcag bya/ bcag par bya/ bcag bya'i rdo/ lta bu/ ma ning ga da gnyis po ni// zhes pa/ sngon 'jug ma ning ga dang da gnyis po ni dngos po bdag dang*/

dngos po gzhan dang*/ dus da lta ba bcas gsum la 'jug pa las dang po dngos po bdag la 'jug pa ni/ gcod pa po dang gcod par byed// gcod par 'gyur dang dkri ba po// dkri bar byed dang dkri bar 'gyur// zhes sogs dngos po bdag don dang*// zhes pa/ shing gcod pa po/ gcod byed/ gcod par byed/ gcod par 'gyur ro// snal ma dkri ba po/ dkri bar byed/ dkri bar 'gyur/ gsod pa po/ gsod par byed/ rgya mtsho dkrug pa po/ dkrug par byed/ lta bu dngos po bdag gsal byed kyi don du go bar bya'o// gnyis pa/ gcad bya'i shing dang gcad par bya// dkri bya'i snal ma dkri bar bya// zhes sogs dngos po gzhan don dang*// zhes pa/ ma ning ga da gnyis gcad bya'i shing sogs dngos po gzhan don du 'jug pa ni/ gsad bya/ gsad par bya ba/ gsad bya'i lug /dgag bya/ dgag par bya ba/ dgag bya'i skyon/ lta bu/ gsum pa/ gcod bzhin pa dang dkri bzhin pa// zhes sogs da lta sgrub ched 'jug /ces pa/ ma ning ga da gnyis byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i bya ba byed bzhin pa da lta bar 'jug pa ni/ shing gcod bzhin pa/ gcod kyin 'dug /snal ma dkri bzhin pa/ dkri yin 'dug /don gnyer bzhin pa/ gnyer gyin 'dug /zho dkrog bzhin pa/ dkrog pa'i sgang yin/ lta bu byed las gsal byed kyi sgra tshig grogs kyis bsgyur ba 'di rnams da lta ba bsgrub pa'i ched du 'jug go /

mo yig 'a ni bdag dngos dang*/ bdag don phal pa dang*/ dus da lta ba dang*/ ma 'ongs pa bcas bzhi la 'jug /dang po bdag dngos ni/ mo yig 'a ni 'chad pa po// 'chad par byed dang 'chad par 'gyur// zhes sogs dngos po bdag dngos dang*/ /zhes pa/ chos 'chad pa po/ 'chad par byed/ 'chad par 'gyur/ mdud pa 'grol ba po/ 'grol byed/ 'grol bar 'gyur/ de sogs dngos po bdag yin pas de bsgrub pa'i phyir 'jug go /gnyis pa bdag don phal pa ni/ 'gro ba po dang 'gro bar byed// ces sogs bdag don phal pa dang*// zhes pa/ mo yig bdag don phal pa la 'jug pa'i dpe ni/ lam du 'gro ba po/ 'gro bar byed/ 'gro bar 'gyur ro// mgo 'khor ba po/ 'khor byed/ phyogs shar nas 'char ba po/ 'char byed/ 'od 'tsher ba po/ 'tsher byed/ sogs bya byed ngo bo gcig pa'am tha mi dad par snang ba'i bdag don phal pa la 'jug go /gsum pa dus da lta ba ni/ 'khyil lo zhes sogs da lta ba// zhes pa/ chu 'khyil lo// 'khyil bzhin pa/ gdan la 'khod bzhin pa/ 'khod mus yin/ me 'bar bzhin pa/ bde bar 'tsho bzhin pa/ sogs bdag gzhan gyi dbye bas ma bsdus pa'i dus da lta ba bsgrub pa'i phyir 'jug pa'o// bzhi pa dus ma 'ongs pa ni/ 'khyil bar 'gyur sogs ma 'ongs 'jug /ces pa/ chu 'khyil bar 'gyur/ sman 'ju bar 'gyur/ lus 'tsho bar 'gyur/ de la sogs pa bya byed tha mi dad du snang ba'i bya ba byed 'gyur ma 'ongs pa bsgrub pa'i phyir 'jug go / shin tu mo yi ma yig ni// bdag gzhan dus gsum mnyam par 'jug /ces pa/ sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig ni bdag gzhan gnyis dang dus gsum ste thams cad la mnyam par 'jug /de yang bdag la 'jug pa ni/ mkhyen pa po/ mkhas par byed/ lta bu/ gzhan la 'jug pa ni/ mkhas bya/ mchod bya/ mchod par bya/ lta bu/ dus 'das pa la 'jug pa ni/ mkhyen to// mkhas par byas/ mgu bar byas/ lta bu/ dus da lta bar 'jug pa ni/

mkhyen bzhin pa/ mjal bzhin pa/ mthun gyin 'dug /lta bu/ ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pa ni/ mkhas par 'gyur/ mdza' bar 'gyur/ mthun par 'gyur/ lta bu kun la mnyam par 'jug go / 'on kyang byed po gzhan dngos dang*// 'brel ba'i 'das la 'a'i sngon 'jug /med par nges shing ga da nyung*// zhes pa/ 'on kyang byed po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i 'das tshig rnams la 'a'i sngon 'jug med par nges shing*/ der ma zad ga da gnyis kyang nyung bar yod do zhes pa'o// da lta ba la ba'i sngon 'jug /nyung zhing mgo can da lta bar// bas 'phul med par nges pa tsam// zhes pa/ da lta ba'i tshig rnams la ba yig gi sngon 'jug nyung bar ma zad/ ra la sa'i mgo can da lta ba rnams la yang ba 'phul med par nges pa tsam yin/ zhes pa'o// gzhan yang bas 'phul can phal cher/ /byed pa po ni da lta dang*// bya yul ma 'ongs par bsdus nas// zhes pa/ gzhan yang ba'i 'phul rten can phal cher byed pa po dang*/ bya yul gnyis las byed pa po ni da lta ba'i khongs dang*/ bya yul ma 'ongs pa'i khongs su bsdus nas dus 'das pa dang*/ da lta ba dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ skul tshig bcas bzhi ru dbye bar bya'o// dang po ni/ 'das la bas 'phul yang 'jug yod// ces pa/ mgo can 'das tshig rnams la ba sogs sngon 'jug dang yang 'jug gnyis ka 'jug ste/ dper na/ lha bsgoms/ lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ da lta ba la gnyis ka med// ces pa/ da lta ba'i tshig rnams la sngon 'jug yang 'jug gang yang mi 'jug pa'i dpe ni/ sgrub pa po/ sgrub byed/ sgrub par byed/ sgrub bo// lta bu/ gsum pa/ ma 'ongs 'phul yod yang 'jug med// ces pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i tshig rnams la 'phul yod yang 'jug med pa'i dpe ni/ bsgrub bya/ bsgrub par bya/ bsgrub bya'i lha/ lta bu/ bzhi pa skul tshig rnams la yang 'jug yod med gnyis/ dang po yod pa ni/ skul tshig 'phul med yang 'jug yod// ces pa/ skul tshig rnams la 'phul rten sngon 'jug med cing*/

yang 'jug yod pa'i dpe ni/ sgrubs shig /srungs shig /lta bu/ gnyis pa yang 'jug med pa ni/ skabs 'gar 'das dang skul tshig la// sa rkyang sbyar bas 'thus pa'ang yod// ces pa/ 'das tshig dang skul tshig phal cher la yang 'jug thob kyang*/ skabs 'gar 'das pa dang skul tshig gnyis la sa rkyang sbyar bas 'thus pa ste chog pa'ang yod de/ 'das pa la sa rkyang sbyar bas 'thus pa ni/ byas/ 'das/ bltas/ lta bu/ skul tshig la sa rkyang sbyar bas 'thus pa ni/ gyis shig /ltos shig /skus/ lta bu/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po yi// ga da ba sa bzhi rnams pho// nga ma 'a gsum mo yin cing*// na ra la gsum ma ning ste// ming gzhi'i yi ge kun la 'jug /ces pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa ste/ ga nga da na ba ma 'a// ra la sa rnams rjes 'jug bcu// zhes pa ltar rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po de rnams la nang gses dbye na gsum du yod/ gsum gang zhe na/ pho dang*/ mo dang*/ ma ning ste gsum du 'gyur ro// dang po ni/ ga dang*/ da dang*/ ba dang*/ sa bcas bzhi ni pho yig go /gnyis pa/ nga dang*/ ma dang*/ 'a bcas gsum ni mo yig go /gsum pa/ na dang*/ ra dang*/ la bcas gsum ni ma ning gi yi ge'o// de rnams ming gzhi'i yi ge kun la 'jug pa yin no// zhes pa'o// ji ltar 'jug tshul gnyis yin te// zhes pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug tshul bshad pa ste rjes 'jug rnams ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul la gnyis yod pa yin te/ sgra'i 'jug tshul dang*/ don gyi 'jug tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dang po sgra yi 'jug tshul ni// zhes pa/ dang po sgra yi 'jug tshul de la yang rjes 'jug pho gsum ni ming gzhi'i yi ge gang la zhugs kyang brjod pa'i sgra gdangs drag par 'jug pa dang*/ mo gnyis ni sgra gdangs zhan par 'jug pa dang*/ ma ning gsum ni bar ma ste sgra gdangs ran par 'jug pa yin no// pho la yang nang gses sgra rtsol drag pa rnams skyes bu rab dang*/

de las cung zad zhan pa bar ma rnams skyes bu 'bring dang*/ de las kyang shin tu zhan pa skyes bu tha ma ste gsum du yod pa'i dang po ni/ pho yi ga yig yang 'jug can// skyes bu rab dang*/ zhes pa/ rjes 'jug gi pho ga yig la yang 'jug sa zhugs na skyes bu rab yin te/ dper na/ mdo bklags/ don gzigs/ lta bu dang*/ pho yig ba// yang 'jug can rnams skyes bu 'bring*// zhes pa/ pho yig ba yang 'jug dang 'brel na skyes bu 'bring yin te/ dper na/ skyabs/ bsgrubs/ stobs/ lta bu'o// ga ba yang 'jug med pa dang*// da sa'i mtha' can tha ma ste// zhes pa/ ga dang ba gnyis yang 'jug med pa dang*/ da sa'i mtha' can te da dang sa rjes 'jug tu yod pa rnams skyes bu tha ma yin te/ dper na/ bdag /mchog /khab/ rab/ yod/ bstod/ skyes/ bzhes/ lta bu'o// drag pa pho la'ang nang gses kyis// drag zhan bar ma gsum du dbye// zhes pa/ drag pa pho'i yi ge la'ang nang gses kyis drag pa skyes bu rab dang*/ bar ma skyes bu 'bring dang*/ zhan pa skyes bu tha ma ste bshad ma thag pa bzhin gsum du 'gyur ro// de bzhin zhan pa mo la yang*// nang gses drag zhan gnyis dbye ste// zhes pa/ pho la skyes bu gsum du dbye ba de bzhin du zhan pa mo la yang nang gses drag pa mo dang*/ zhan pa shin tu mo ste gnyis su dbye ste/ nga ma yang 'jug can mo dang*// zhes pa/ nga dang*/ ma gnyis yang 'jug can rnams drag pa mo tsam yin te/ dper na/ bzhengs/ gangs/ dbyings/ byams/ bsgoms/ rnams/ lta bu'o// gnyis pa/ nga ma yang 'jug med pa dang*// 'a mtha' can rnams shin tu mo// zhes pa/ nga dang ma gnyis yang 'jug med pa dang*/ 'a dang bcas gsum po rnams kyi mtha' can te rjes 'jug ni shin tu mo yin pa'i dpe ni/ mthong*/ zhing*/ gsum/ gtam/ bka'/ dga'/ mkha'/ mda'/ lta bu'o// bar ma ma ning na ra la/ /yang 'jug yod dam med kyang rung*// ming gzhi pho yig mthar yod dang*/

/ming gzhi ma ning rjes su ni// yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pa na// drag dang 'phrad pas drag par 'gyur// zhes pa/ sgra gdangs bar ma ma ning na ra la gsum po 'di la yang 'jug yod dam med kyang rung ming gzhi pho yig gi mthar yod pa dang*/ ming gzhi ma ning gi rjes su yang 'jug dang bcas te zhugs pa na sgra gdangs drag pa dang 'phrad pa yin pas drag par 'gyur te/ dper na ming gzhi pho yig dang 'phrad pa ni/ kun/ dkon/ bkar/ bkol/ skul/ can/ gcerd/ bcold/ gtan/ bstand/ dpon/ spar/ dpal/ speld/ brtson/ btsird/ bstsald/ sogs so// ming gzhi ma ning gi rjes su yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pa ni/ 'khond/ chard/ thard/ phuld/ tshard/ lta bu drag dang 'phrad pas drag par 'gyur ba'o// 'di skabs si dngul gnyis cung mi 'dra ba 'dug /ming gzhi mo yig rjes su ni// yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na/ /zhan dang 'phrad pas zhan par 'gyur// zhes pa/ na ra la gsum ming gzhi mo yig gi rjes su ni yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na zhan dang 'phrad pas zhan par 'gyur te/ dper na/ 'gran/ 'gor/ mgul/ ljon/ 'jur/ mjal/ don/ 'bar/ 'dzul/ gzhon/ zur/ 'ol/ g.yon/ bshor/ gsal/ sogs so// de gnyis 'gyur ba ma ning yin// zhes pa/ gong gi drag zhan gnyis po de 'gyur ba ma ning ste 'gyur ba zhes pa'i don ni ming gzhi drag pa dang 'phrad na drag pa dang*/ ming gzhi zhan pa dang 'phrad na zhan par 'gyur ba ste rang gso mi zin pas na 'gyur ba zhes brjod pa yin no// ming gzhi mo yig rjes su ni// yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pa na// drag zhan gnyis ka'i cha ldan phyir// mtshan gnyis ma ning zhes su grags// zhes pa/ na ra la gsum ming gzhi mo yig gi rjes su yang 'jug dang bcas te zhugs pa na drag zhan gnyis ka'i cha dang ldan pa'i phyir/ mtshan gnyis ma ning zhes su grags pa yin te/ dper na/ bsgard/ brgald/ 'jald/ dond/ dbend/ 'dzard/ bzhard/ zind/ zurd/ 'aund/ g.yuld/ shard/

gsold/ lta bu ming gzhi mo yig dang 'phrad pas mo'i cha dang ldan/ yang 'jug pho yig dang 'phrad pas pho'i cha dang ldan pas mtshan gnyis dang*/ rjes 'jug kho rang ma ning yin pas mtshan gnyis ma ning zhes brjod do// ming gzhi ma ning rjes su ni// yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na// drag zhan gang du'ang mi 'gyur bas// mtshan med ma ning zhes su 'dod// ces pa/ ming gzhi ma ning kha cha tha pha tsha lnga'i rjes su ni yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na drag zhan gang du'ang mi 'gyur te/ dper na/ mkhan/ 'khor/ khal/ chen/ 'char/ 'chal/ mthun/ thur/ mthol/ phan/ 'phur/ 'phel/ tshon/ tshur/ 'tshol/ lta bu ming gzhi dang rjes 'jug gnyis ka ma ning yin cing pho mo'i mtshan ma gang yang med pas mtshan med ma ning zhes su 'dod do// gnyis pa ni/ gnyis pa don la gnyis yod pa'i// zhes pa/ gnyis pa don gyi 'jug tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba bshad pa dang*/ phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba ni// rjes 'jug gang la zhugs pa yi// ming des bdag gzhan sogs gang ston// zhes pa/ rjes 'jug de rnams gang la zhugs pa'i ming de nyid ming mtha' sogs la ltos nas snga mar grub pa yin pas des bdag gzhan sogs gang dang gang ston pa ni/ phal cher ming de'i sngon 'jug gi /nus par sbyar nas rtogs par bya// zhes pa/ ming des don gang ston pa phal cher ming de'i sngon 'jug lnga las gang zhig yin pa de'i nus par sbyar nas bdag gzhan dus gsum sogs gang yin rtogs par bya dgos te/ dper na/ rjes 'jug pho bzhi ci rigs par dus 'das pa la 'jug pa/ bsgrigs/ bsgrubs/ bkag /btab/ bshad/ brtas/ lta bu/ bdag la 'jug pa ni/ 'grogs byed/ 'debs byed/ 'gog byed/ sgrub byed/ sdud byed/ mdzes byed/ lta bu dang*/ de rnams gzhan la 'jug pa ni/ gdags bya/ dgag bya/ bsgrub bya/ brjod bya/ lta bu dang*/ bdag gzhan gyi dbye bas ma bsdus pa'i dus da lta bar 'jug pa ni/

'phags bzhin pa/ 'jug bzhin pa/ 'grub bzhin pa/ 'khod bzhin pa/ dgyes bzhin pa/ lta bu dang*/ dus ma 'ongs par 'jug pa ni/ 'byid par 'gyur/ 'jib par 'gyur/ gzhug par 'gyur/ 'thob par 'gyur/ 'chad par 'gyur/ lta bu dang*/ des mtshon nas mo gnyis dang ma ning gsum la yang shes par bya'o// ming rkyang tsam ni/ gdugs/ stobs/ bdag /g.yab/ tshod/ dus/ lta bu dang*/ zhugs shig /sgrubs shig /lta bu skul tshig dang*/ de ltar sngon 'jug la ltos pa gtso bor gsungs pa'i zhar la sngon 'jug med kyang gong bzhin bdag gzhan sogs ston nus pa'ang shes dgos pa ni/ rtogs byed/ rtogs zin/ rtsom byed/ gleng bya/ skor bzhin pa/ ston par 'gyur/ skyobs shig /byas/ lta bu dang*/ da sa'i yang 'jug gis 'das pa rang dbang du ston pa/ dper na/ gyurd/ 'das/ byas/ grags/ lta bu'o// de ltar sa'i 'jug gsum gyis 'das pa dang*/ 'a mtha' 'das pa la gtan nas mi 'jug pa'i khyad par tsam las gzhan ma 'jug yul bdag gzhan sogs gang yin tshig grogs kyis bsgyur ba'i nus par shes dgos pa yin no// gnyis pa/ phyi ma ji ltar 'gyur ba ni// zhes pa/ phyi ma dag gi ming mtha' ji ltar 'gyur ba rnam dbye so so'i thob thang la dbye na bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rjes 'jug pho yis pho yig gi /ming mtha' gzhan drang*// zhes pa/ ming snga ma'i mtha'i rjes 'jug rtags gsum gang yin pa de'i ming de nyid kyi cha nas mthar sbyor dgos pa'i ming mtha' yin na rtags mthun par 'dren pa shas che bas rjes 'jug phos ming gzhi pho'i ming mtha' 'dren pa/ dper na/ rtog pa/ dpyid ka /thad ka /gnyis ka /mkhyend pa/ 'byord pa/ dgongs pa/ lta bu/ gnyis pa/ de bzhin du// mo yis mo yi ming mtha' drang*// zhes pa/ gong du rjes 'jug phos pho'i ming mtha' drangs pa de bzhin du mo yis mo'i ming mtha' drang bar bya ste/ dper na/ gsing ma/ tham ga /snying ga /dga' ba/ lta bu dang*/ gsum pa/ ma ning gis ni ma ning drang*// zhes pa/

rjes 'jug ma ning gis ming gzhi ma ning drang bar bya ste/ dper na/ dgun kha/ dbyar kha/ spar kha/ 'phal kha/ gsal kha/ lta bu dang*/ de rnams rtags mtshungs 'dren tshul te// zhes pa/ gong gi de rnams rjes 'jug gi rtags dang ming gzhi'i rtags rtags mtshungs par 'dren tshul yin te/ zhes pa'o// bzhi pa/ brjod bde 'dren pa'ang shin tu mang*// zhes pa/ gtso che ba rnams ming mtha' dang mthun par 'dren tshul de ltar yin zhing*/ de byings brjod pa bde ba'i ched dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i nyer spyod dang bstun dgos pa sogs kyis 'dren tshul yang shin tu mang bar 'byung ste de rnams kyang bye brag ma 'dzings par rtogs par bya dgos te/ dper na/ phos mo drangs pa/ thog ma/ lta bu dang*/ mos pho drangs pa/ khang pa/ lta bu dang*/ ma ning gis mo drangs pa/ thal mo/ lta bu dang*/ ma ning gis pho drangs pa/ char pa/ lta bu mang du byung ba shes dgos par ma zad/ gzhan yang brda rnying la rtags mtshungs 'dren pa shin tu mang yang skad gsar bcad kyi zhu dag mang bas nub tshul gsungs pa ltar dper na/ brda rnying rtags mtshungs drangs pa ni/ brag ca/ dkon cog /rin cen/ lta bu la brda gsar ni/ brag cha/ dkon mchog /rin chen/ zhes pa 'di rnams kyang rtogs dgos pa'i gnad do// brjod bde 'dren tshul rnams rtags ma mthun kyang brjod bde gtso bor byas nas sgra mthun drangs pa yin pas sum rtags gnyis ka'i dngos bstan gyi dgongs par gnas so//

gzhan yang ming mtha' de nyid kyis// rtags mtshungs pa'am sgra mthun pa'i// rnam dbye brgyad dang slar bsdu sogs// snga ma'i shugs dang mthun par 'dren/ zhes pa/ gong gi ming mtha' 'dren tshul sogs bshad zin pa de las/ gzhan yang rnam dbye dang de min tshig phrad 'dren tshul ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i ming mtha' de nyid kyi snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi shugs kyis rnam dbye sogs rtags phan tshun mtshungs pa'am brjod bde'i sgra mthun pa'i rnam dbye dang po chos rnams ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ gnyis pa las su bya ba/ gsum pa byed sgra/ bzhi pa dgos ched/ lnga pa 'byung khungs/ drug pa 'brel sgra/ bdun pa rten gnas/ brgyad pa bod pa'i sgra bcas brgyad dang*/ dngos su bstan pa slar bsdu/ sogs khongs nas thon pa lhag bcas/ 'byed sdud/ bsnan pa/ bdag sgra/ tshig rgyan/ tshe skabs sogs kyang ming snga ma'i shugs dang mthun pa phyi ma 'dren dgos so zhes pa'o// de dag nang gses gang 'jug ni// rnam dbye'am phrad bcas ming tshig de'i// mthar sbyar ming don las shes bya// zhes pa/ bshad ma thag pa de dag nang gses gang la gang 'jug pa ni/ rnam dbye'am de min tshig phrad bcas ming tshig rnams de'i mthar sbyar rgyu'i ming don 'og ma las legs par shes par bya'o zhes pa'o// de yang chos rnams ngo bo tsam// brjod pa rnam dbye dang po ste// dper na bum pa ka ba bzhin// gsal byed bod kyi skad la nyung*// zhes pa/ bshad ma thag pa de yang chos rnams kyi ngo bo tsam brjod pa rnam dbye dang po yin la de'i gsal byed ni/ dper na/ bum pa/ ka ba/ lha lta bu/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa nyid dag rnams sogs yin yang bod kha ba can pa rnams kyi skad la shin tu nyung ngo*// zhes pa'o// las dang bya yul don gcig ste// de lta'i bya ba'i yul zhig la// bya ba byas par ston pa la// gnyis pa las su bya ba dang*// gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid dang*// bzhi pa dgos ched gsum 'dra yang*// bya ba byas pas bya ba'i yul// de 'am de dang 'brel ba la// phan thogs med na gnyis pa ste// dper na shar du 'gro lta bu// zhes pa/

las dang bya ba'i yul don gcig ste de lta bu'i sgo nas bya ba'i yul zhig la bya ba byas par ston pa de la rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba dang*/ gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid dang*/ bzhi pa dgos ched gsum 'dra bar snang mod/ de rnams kyi dbye ba gang gis 'byed na/ bya ba byas pas bya ba'i yul de 'am de dang 'brel ba la phan thogs med na rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba yin te/ dper na/ shar du 'gro/ lta bu'o// phan thogs yod na bzhi pa ste// dper na slong la byin lta bu// zhes pa/ bya ba byas pas bya ba'i yul de'am de dang 'brel ba'i las la phan thogs yod na rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos ched yin te/ dper na/ dge slong la sbyin/ slong mkhan la ster/ zhing du chu 'dren/ lta bu'o// phan thogs med kyang bya yul dang*/ /bya ba ngo bo gcig yin na// gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid de// dper na lha ru gsal lta bu// zhes pa/ bya ba byas pas bya ba'i yul de la phan thogs med kyang bya ba'i yul dang bya ba gnyis po ngo bo gcig yin na rnam dbye gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid yin te/ dper na/ lha ru gsal/ 'od du 'tsher/ lta bu'o// gang zhig gang la brten pa 'am// gnas dang yod pa'i don tsam las// bya ba gtan nas mi byed na// rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi ste// dper na steng du mi yod ltar// zhes pa/ chos gang zhig gzhi gang la brten pa'am gnas pa'am yod pa'i don ston pa tsam las bya ba gtan nas mi byed pa yin na rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi yin te/ dper na/ steng du mi yod/ dbus su jo bo bzhugs/ lta bu'o// tshe skabs gnyis dang don 'dra na// bdun pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs te// dper na mchu zla shar ba na// cho 'phrul dus chen tshugs lta bu// zhes pa/ tshe dang skabs gnyis kyi don dang 'dra na rnam dbye bdun pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs yin te/ dper na/ hor zla dang po shar ba na cho 'phrul dus chen tshugs/ lta bu'o//

rnam dbye gnyis bzhi bdun pa dang*// de nyid tshe skabs gsal byed sgra// su ru ra du na la tu// yin zhing phal cher la sgra dang*// mthun pas la don rnam dbye'ang zer// zhes pa/ rnam dbye gnyis pa/ bzhi pa/ bdun pa/ gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid/ bdun pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs bcas lnga po 'di rnams kyi don gsal bar byed pa'i sgra ni/ su dang*/ ru dang*/ ra dang*/ du dang*/ na dang*/ la dang*/ tu bcas bdun po 'di rnams yin zhing*/ phal cher la sgra dang 'jug tshul mthun pas na la don dang*/ tshig grogs kyi dbang gis rnam dbyer gyur tshe la don gyi rnam dbye'ang zer ro// 'jug tshul mthun lugs ni/ dbus su 'gro/ dbus la 'gro/ lta bu mthun pas so// 'on kyang na la de nyid la// mi 'jug smra ba'i sgo las gsungs// zhes pa/ 'on kyang na la gnyis ni rnam dbye gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid la mi 'jug pa smra sgo mtshon cha las gsungs te/ smra sgo las/ du la sogs pa la dang mthun// de nyid dag ni lhag pa yin// gsungs so// 'dir yang phal cher zhes ma nges pa'i tshig smos pa dper na/ lha na gsal/ 'od la 'tsher/ lta bu sbyar mi rung ba'i don to// rnam dbye gang la sbyor yul des// nye 'gyang gang du bya ba zhig /byas na gsum pa byed sgra ste// dper na bdag gis bshad lta bu// zhes pa/ rnam dbye gang la sbyor yul des nye ba dang 'gyang ba gang rigs su bya ba zhig byas na rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra ste/ dper na/ bdag gis bshad/ mig gis lta/ lta bu nye ba dang*/ mig gis shel rtse'i rtse mo nas phyogs thams cad du yang dang yang du legs par bltas so// lta bu 'gyang ba'o// bya ba gtan nas mi byed par// snga phyi 'brel byed tsam ston na// rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra ste// dper na bdag gi mig lta bu// zhes pa/ las sam bya ba'i yul la bya ba gtan nas mi byed par tshig snga ma dang phyi ma 'brel byed tsam ston na rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra zhes bya ste/

dper na/ bdag gi mig /khab kyi rtse/ lta bu'o// rnam dbye drug gsum gsal byed sgra// sa mtha' yod dang med pa yi// gi kyi gyi 'i yi lnga yin// zhes pa/ rnam dbye drug pa dang gsum pa gnyis gsal bar byed pa'i sgra ni/ tshig gi mtha' na sa yod pa/ gis/ kyis/ gyis/ 'is/ yis dang*/ tshig gi mtha' na sa med pa/ gi kyi/ gyi/ 'i/ yi lnga po 'di rnams yin no zhes pa'o// gang zhig gang las 'byung ba'am// bye dang lhung ba'i don ldan na// rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs te// dper na zhal nas thos lta bu// gsal byed sgra ni nas las te// dgar dang sdud pa'ang lnga par gtogs// zhes pa/ chos gang zhig gzhi gang las byung ba'am bye ba'am lhung ba'i don dang ldan na rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs zhes bya ste/ dper na/ zhal nas legs bshad thos/ rgya mtsho nas nor bu 'byung*/ lta bu dang*/ de rnams gsal byed kyi sgra ni nas las gnyis yin cing*/ der ma zad dgar ba dang sdud pa gnyis kyang rnam dbye lnga pa'i khongs su gtogs te/ dper na/ lha yi nang nas brgya sbyin mchog /lta bu dgar ba dang*/ spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil bar/ lta bu sdud pa'o// gzhan yang tshig don gong 'og tu// bsdu rgyu yod na sdud pa'i sgra// dang dang kyang yang 'ang sogs sbyor// zhes pa/ gzhan yang tshig gi don gong dang 'og gang rigs su bsdu rgyu yod na sdud pa'i sgra/ dang dang*/ kyang dang*/ yang dang*/ 'ang sogs sbyor dgos te/ dper na/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te lta bu sdud pa dang*/ bsad kyang lang*/ mgo yang gug /skra'ang dkar/ lta bu'o// rnam grangs du mas don bskyar na// 'byed sdud sgra 'jug /ces pa/ rnam grangs du mas don bskyar dgos na snga ma snga mar 'byed sdud kyi sgra 'jug ste/ dper na/ don bskyar ba/ 'chi med dam/ rnam sad dam/ mig mi 'dzum ni lha'o// lta bu dang*/ tshig bskyar ba/ pad+ma dkar po'am pad+ma dkar po lta bu'i sems dpa'/

lta bu dang*/ tshig don gnyis ka bskyar ba/ bskor zhing bskor zhing slar yang de ru 'bab// lta bu'o// dgag pa dang*// bdag don yod na thog mtha' ru// pa sde'i rtags rnams ci rigs 'jug /ces pa/ pa sde'i khongs nas byung ba'i ma yig thog mtha' bar gsum gang du zhugs kyang dgag pa'am dgag sgra yin te/ ma yin/ mi 'dug /bdag min/ 'dre med/ mi skya ma yin/ ga ma sa/ lta bu dang*/ pa sde'i khongs nas byung ba'i pa dang*/ ba dang*/ ma ste pho mo ma ning rtags rnams ci rigs ston pa'i bdag sgra ming gzhi'i mtha' ru zhugs na bdag po'i don gsal bar byed pa yin te/ dper na/ rta pa/ nang ma/ lha rtse ba/ lta bu'o// rgyan du gyur pa'i tshig phrad kyang*// don la bsnyegs sa yod na sbyor// zhes pa/ rgyan du gyur pa'i tshig gi 'phrad rnams kyang don la bsnyegs sa ste sbyor sa yod na sbyor dgos te/ dper na/ mdzes kyang mdzes/ btud kyang khro lta bu dang*/ mi dgos par sbyor mi rigs so// de bzhin bstan bya lhag yod na// lhag bcas sgra sbyor/ zhes pa/ bshad ma thag pa'i tshig rgyan gyi sbyor tshul de bzhin du bstan bya lhag ma yod na lhag bcas kyi sgra sbyor dgos te/ dper na/ don rtogs te nyams su blangs/ lta bu'o// tshig don ni// rdzogs na slar bsdu'i sgra rnams sbyor// zhes pa/ gang brjod rgyu'i tshig don ni rdzogs na slar bsdu'i sgra rnams sbyor dgos te/ dper na/ mchog go /bzang ngo*// lta bu'o// rjes 'jug gi dgos pa bstan pa ni/ dgos pa ci phyir 'jug ce na// mo yig dbyangs dang mi ldan na// pho yig gsal byed brjod mi nus// zhes pa/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge rnams dgos pa ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ mo'i yi ge dbyangs yig rnams dang mi ldan na/ pho yig gsal byed rnams brjod mi nus pa yin no zhes pa'o// de phyir dbyangs lngar bzhed pa bde// pho yig dbyangs ldan de dag la'ang*// rjes 'jug bcu po ma zhugs na// don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i// ming dang don gyi khyad par rnams// ston pa'i tshig dang don ldan pa'i// ngag gi brjod pa yod min te// yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung zhing*// ming gi khongs nas tshig phyung nas// tshig gis don rnams ston pas so// zhes pa/

rgyu mtshan de'i phyir dbyangs yig dngos bstan bzhi dang shugs bstan a bcas lngar bzhed pa bde bar ma zad pho'i yi ge ka sogs la dbyangs sam gi gu sogs dang ldan pa de dag la'ang rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po gang rung zhig ma zhugs na don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming dang*/ don gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshig dang*/ brjod bya'i don dang ldan pa'i ngag gi brjod pa gang yang yod min te/ yi ge'i khongs sam nang nas ming dbyung ba ste byung zhing*/ ming gi khongs nas tshig rnams phyung nas tshig gis don rnams ma 'dres par so sor ston par nus pas so zhes pa'o// ming tshig brjod pa med na ni// mthun mong mthun mong ma yin pa'i// shes bya ston pa'ang med par 'gyur// zhes pa/ ming dang tshig gi brjod pa med na ni phyi rol pa dang mthun mong pa'i snyan dngags la sogs pa'i rig byed rnams dang*/ mthun mong ma yin pa thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i mdo sngags kyi bka' bstan bcos rnams kyi gzhung don la shes par bya ba'i yul ston pa'ang med par 'gyur ro// zhes pa'o// de phyir 'phags yul mkhas rnams kyi// rjes su 'brangs nas gsungs pa 'di// skye bo kun gyis rtogs gyur cig /ces pa/ dgos pa de'i phyir na rgya gar 'phags yul du byon pa'i mkhas pa chen po bram ze li bi ka ra la sogs pa rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas thon mi nyid kyi brtse bas kun nas bslangs te gsungs pa'i bstan bcos sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa 'di gnyis kyi dgongs don rnams phyin ci ma log par gangs can gyi skye bo kun gyis bde blag tu rtogs par gyur cig ces thugs smon mdzad pa'o// tshig gi sgra tsam 'dra na yang*// don la khyad par shin tu che// de phyir brda dag la brten nas// ma nor don rnams 'tshol ba gces// zhes pa/ ming phan tshun tshig gi sgra tsam 'dra bar snang yang don la khyad par shin tu che ba yod de/

dper na/ gri lta bur mtshon na/ ga gri/ da dri/ ba bri/ sogs phan tshun ming gzhi'i sgra tsam 'dra na yang so sor 'byed na mtshon gyi ral gri la ga gri/ sna la bsnam bya'i dri la da dri/ ri mo bri la ba bri sogs khyad par shin tu che ste/ de yang sngon rgyal po wang dang*/ gung gnyis mi mthun pa'i gzhi yi ge 'bri ba pos da dri ga gri nor 'khrul byung rkyen gyis 'thab rtsod byung ba'i lo rgyus kyang gsungs so// rgyu mtshan de'i phyir bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs pad bsten nas brda dag par byed pa'i brda sprod kyi gzhung rnams la brten nas sbyangs stobs phul phyin gyis ming tshig rnams kyi dbye ba ma nor bar byas nas don rnams 'tshol ba snying gi dbus su gces par gzung dgos so// zhes pa'o// don la mi rmongs rmongs pa yang*// lugs 'dir mkhas min gyis byed de// sgra shes don la mi rmongs zhes// mkhas pa'i gsung la yongs su grags// zhes pa/ de ltar brda dag gi gzhung la thos bsam gyi sgo nas zhugs na rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang dgongs 'grel rgya bod mkhas grub kyi gzhung don rnams kyi dgongs pa 'byed pa la mi rmongs pa'i blo gros mchog tu rgyas nas mkhas pa chen por 'gyur zhing*/ brda dag gzhung la thos bsam gyis ma zhugs na bka' dang dgongs 'grel ma zad tha na srid kyi bya bzhag gi don la'ang mi shes pa'i rmongs par 'gyur ba ste/ de ltar rmongs mi rmongs kyang rtsa ba brda sprod kyi gzhung sum rtags gnyis po 'dir mkhas mi mkhas kyis byed de bod du sgra sum rtags yin zhing*/ sgra shes na don la mi rmongs zhes rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung la yang yongs su grags pa yin no zhes pa'o// 'di la ma sbyangs rmongs tshod kyis// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i grwar 'jug pa// wa skyes seng lpags gyon pa bzhin// nam zhig rjes ngan gsal bar 'gyur// zhes pa/

brda dag gi gzhung lugs kun gyi ma phyir gyur pa sum rtags 'di la ma sbyangs pa'am ma bslab par rmongs tshod spyi brtol gyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don gzhan la 'chad pa dang*/ pha rol po dang rtsod pa byed pa dang*/ rang gis rtsom pa sogs mkhas pa'i bgyi ba gsum gyi grwar ram gras su 'jug par byed pa de ni/ dper na wa skyes seng ge'i pags pa gyon pa de gnas skabs seng ge lta bur mngon na'ang dus nam zhig gi tshe wa'i gzugs brnyan gsal bar mthong ba'i rjes ngan ston pa de bzhin du skabs der 'chad rtsod sogs grwar zhugs kyang nam zhig ma sbyangs pa'i rjes ngan rnams gsal bar ston par 'gyur ro zhes pa'o// de phyir blo gsal don gnyer rnams// rtags 'jug dka' gnad gzugs brnyan kun// gsal bar 'char ba'i me long 'dir// la 'ur gzigs mor spyon dang kye// zhes pa/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir blo gsal thos bsam gyi don gnyer dang ldan pa rnams rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad dam don rtogs dka' zhing gnad che ba rnams kyi gzugs brnyan kun ma 'dres par gsal bar 'char ba'i me long 'di nyid kyi ngos la la 'ur te mgyogs par gzigs mo 'am ltad mo lta bar spyon dang kye zhes bos pa ni da lta 'dir byon cig blo gsal rnams/ zhes pa'o//

'di la nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na// gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyan sngar 'chags// zhes pa/ rtags 'jug dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long 'di la nor 'khrul gyi nongs pa ste nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na/ gzur gnas sam drang por gnas pa'i mkhas pa kun gyi spyan sngar mthol lo 'chags sam bshags so// zhes pa'o// cung zad 'bad las thob pa'i dges// kun gyis 'di don rtogs par shog /ces pa/ dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje bdag gis rtags 'jug gzhung 'di nyid bskrun pa'i ngal ba cung zad 'bad las thob pa'i dge ba des gangs can 'gro ba kun gyis 'di'i don legs par rtogs nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la sogs pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rnams mthar phyin par byed nus par shog cig /ces bsngo smon mdzad do// 'dir smras pa/ thu mi'i thugs bskyed chu gter bsrubs pa las// 'ongs pa'i sum rtags dgos 'dod nor gyi dbyig /phan bde'i 'od 'bar snang ba'i dpal yon can// 'di ko sngon byon mkhas rnams mig bzhin gces// de phyir gzhung 'grel nam mkha'i skar tshogs bzhin// rang rang khyer so'i 'phro 'du mkhas pa'i dbus// skal bzang kun+da'i 'dzum pa lhug po ru// 'grol nus dngul chu'i legs bshad zla snang mchog /e ma brda dag gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mtha'// byis blo'i mig gi spyod yul ga la zhig /de slad 'di la nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na// gzur gnas mkhas la 'chags so byi dor mdzod// cung zad 'bad las thob pa'i dge ba'i cha// kha ba dung dang pad rtsa 'o mtsho ltar// dkar ba gang des lung rtogs dam pa'i chos// rang gzhan rgyud la mchog tu rgyas gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang rang slob rtse drung rgyal mtshan chos ldan lags kyis rtags 'jug dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long gi 'grel pa phal tshig go bde ba zhig dgos zhes nan gyis bskul bar/ rang ngos nas 'di ltar smra ba'i spobs pa rdul phran tsam ma mchis kyang skul ba po'i gsung ngo ma ldog par spyi brtol bskyed nas bhik+ṣu dka' chen pad+mas skyes bu'i don grub 'bras bu zla ba'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum pa'i nyin mjug grub par bgyis pa'o/// /

oṃ swasti sid+dhi rastu/ deng 'dir gsung rab rin chen 'phrul par du// bzhengs dges legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum du// bgyis pa'i dge tshogs dri ma med pa rnams// gcig tu bsdoms te mthun rkyen sgrub rnams dang*// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe ring 'byor ldan zhing*// ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te// bla med rnam grol thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// bstan 'dzin dam pa gang na su bzhugs rnams// sku tshe'i rkyen gegs tha dag rab zhi nas// bstan 'gro'i don chen bla med mdzad bzhin du// dam chos bdud rtsi'i sbrang char 'bebs gyur cig /yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu lo legs shing*// nad mug 'khrug rtsod thams cad zhi ba dang*// mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags par// rdzogs ldan dang po'i lang tsho 'char bar shog /de'i mthus kha ba ris pa'i skye dgu'i yid// rnam dkar dge ba'i las la phyogs pa dang*// mthun rkyen legs tshogs gong nas gong 'phel te// dam chos 'dzin pa'i snod du rung bar shog /'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na pad+mo yi// zhabs pad bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir myur bkod de// zhi bsil chos kyi bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ror// longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang myur 'char shog /khyad par bstan pa'i snying po sgrub brgyud kyi// ring lugs dri med sa chen yongs khyab ste// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// sku tshe mi 'gyur tshe lha'i ngo bor brtan// phrin las mi zad nyi zla'i 'od dang sdeb// 'dus tshogs dge 'dun bgrang yas rgyu skar la// zab rgyas chos kyi gru char 'bebs par shog /lha rnams mkha' la shis pa'i glu dbyangs len// 'gro rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i yun du 'tsho// klu rnams dga' bas nor 'dzin dbyig gis bkang*// mthar thug sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog
